sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith Master - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello. A new order came in for an imported HK 416A5 rifle, the black variant. I spent some time thinking about who to assign it to, and realized you're the only one who can handle it right now. From now on, I'll be giving you more challenging jobs. The client wants the rifle built using tan or FDE-colored components: a SureFire SOCOM556-RC2 suppressor, Magpul RVG foregrip, EOTech EXPS3-0 holographic sight, Magpul MOE pistol grip, Magpul UBR GEN2 stock, an LA-5B/PEQ tactical device, and a magazine with a capacity of at least 30 rounds. It needs at least 50 ergonomics, no more than 310 total recoil, and must weigh under 4 kilograms. Just like something you'd see in the hands of some SOF guys, right? One more thing: try to find a rifle that hasn't been beaten to hell. Its durability must be at least 80%."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify an HK 416A5 to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- 1× AR-15 HK Ergo PSG-1 style pistol grip
- 1× AR-15 Strike Industries Advanced Receiver Extension
- Unlocks purchase of AR-15 HK Ergo PSG-1 style pistol grip at Mechanic LL4
- Unlocks purchase of AR-15 Strike Industries Advanced Receiver Extension at Mechanic LL4
"A real door kicker blaster! Thank you for the help, mercenary."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
HK 416A5 specifications:
- 80 Durability
- 50 or more ergonomics
- 310 or less recoil
- 4 kg or less in weight
- 300 or greater sighting range
- A magazine with a capacity of at least 30
- SureFire SOCOM556-RC2 5.56x45 sound suppressor
- Magpul RVG foregrip (FDE)
- EOTech EXPS3-0 holographic sight (Tan)
- AR-15 Magpul UBR GEN2 stock (FDE)
- AR-15 Magpul MOE pistol grip (FDE)
- L3Harris LA-5B/PEQ tactical device

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard black HK 416A5 from Peacekeeper LL3. It can only be purchased after completing Weapons Circulation.
- Make sure that the chamber is empty, otherwise the gun will be too heavy.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
